subject: Throughput spike & error rate: proposed remediation and credit workflow
messages:
From: Elena Ortiz <elena@halcyonhealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: support@halcyonhealth.com
Date: Wed, 27 Oct 2027 17:34:00 -0700
Subject: Major throughput drop + rising 5xxs (Oct 26-27) — immediate ask

Hi Olga,

We experienced a severe throughput shortfall and an uptick in 5xx errors between 03:00-09:00 UTC on Oct 27. This affected approximately 18% of our inference traffic and resulted in degraded response times for our production chat flows. Our engineering team captured traces and a usage ledger — attaching a summary for your review.

Halcyon depends on Redwood for low p95 latency; this incident caused a number of escalations from our product and ops teams. We need: a clear root cause, an ETA for restoring steady-state throughput, and a proposal for commercial remediation (credits or invoice adjustment) per our SLA.

Attaching: incident_report_20271027.pdf and usage_ledger_20271027.csv

Please escalate to your leadership if needed — we will set up an exec bridge if helpful.

Thanks,
Elena Ortiz
Head of Platform Reliability, Halcyon Health
elena@halcyonhealth.com

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena@halcyonhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 27 Oct 2027 18:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Major throughput drop + rising 5xxs (Oct 26-27) — immediate ask

Hi Elena — thank you for the quick summary and artifacts. I'm escalating this to our reliability and sales leadership. Initial notes: we see an anomaly in request routing affecting a subset of dedicated pools during the window you noted; Monica is taking point on the technical triage.

Next steps from Redwood:
- Monica will lead a 90‑minute deep-dive (logs + kernel selection traces) and share a preliminary RCA within 8 hours.
- We'll propose short-term mitigations (route fallback + explicit instance warmup) to prevent recurrence.
- For commercial remediation, Ben (cc'd) will propose a credit construct tied to the impacted token volume and p95 SLA miss.

I can join an exec bridge if you set one up, but we'll also schedule a customer briefing tomorrow at 10:00 PT to walk you through our findings.

Olga
Olga Petrov
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.com

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 28 Oct 2027 07:44:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Halcyon incident — preliminary findings and mitigation

Team — quick internal summary after the 90-minute triage:
- Root cause (prelim): A routing table rollback during a scheduled kernel rollout caused a subset of requests to hit a slightly incompatible quantized kernel on a small fraction (~18%) of the dedicated pool. That kernel path raised transient level 5xx responses under sustained burst loads.
- Impact window: 2027-10-27 03:02:11 UTC to 2027-10-27 09:06:53 UTC (matches customer ledger).
- Immediate remediations applied: 1) Forced rollback of the kernel selection for the affected pools; 2) Temporary routing rule to prefer verified pool variants; 3) Short-term downscaling of burst concurrency for those instances to avoid cache-thrashing. All applied at 2027-10-27 09:21 UTC.
- Mitigation effect: error rate returned to baseline within ~6 minutes of rollback; throughput recovered to expected p95 within 18 minutes.

Commercial posture recommendation (Ben / Vivek):
- Offer a two-part remediation: (A) usage-proportional credit covering impacted tokens during the window, and (B) a short-term goodwill credit to cover operational overhead and exec coordination.
- Provide a technical remediation write-up (RCA + safeguards) and a 90‑day rollout freeze on kernel changes that touch the dedicated pools for Halcyon, plus a preferential canary schedule.

I'll prepare the RCA doc and the ops timeline. Olga, please coordinate the customer briefing and confirm whether Halcyon will accept the proposed time.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

[attachment: sla_term_excerpt.pdf (pdf)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena@halcyonhealth.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 28 Oct 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood proposal: credit calculation and remediation commitments

Elena — thanks again for raising this. On behalf of Redwood leadership: we sincerely apologize for the disruption. We value Halcyon as a strategic customer. Below is our commercial and technical remediation proposal.

1) Credit calculation (commercial):
- Token-based credit for impacted usage window (2027-10-27 03:02-09:06 UTC): we propose to credit 120% of the billable tokens observed in your attached ledger for that window. This is to compensate for retries, ops time, and downstream margin.
- Goodwill credit: one month of hosted support (value-based) applied to your next invoice.

2) Technical commitments (prevent recurrence):
- Full RCA (Monica) delivered within 48 hours (detailed kernel traces and roll-forward plan).
- 90-day freeze on kernel changes for your Dedicated pools; any change during that window requires a coordinated canary and customer signoff.
- Priority routing for your top-traffic regions and an SLA addendum describing fallback policies.

3) Contract path:
- We will prepare an amendment to the existing order that captures the credits and the rollout guardrails. We aim to have a DocuSign package ready by Oct 30.

If this construct is acceptable in principle, we'll send the formal amendment and RCA. Happy to discuss on the bridge tomorrow.

Ben Carter
Director, Sales (Enterprise), Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

[attachment: commercial_credit_working_calc.xlsx (spreadsheet, referenced)]

From: Elena Ortiz <elena@halcyonhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 30 Oct 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood proposal: credit calculation and remediation commitments

Ben / Olga / Monica — thank you for the rapid work and the clear plan. The proposal looks reasonable and appreciated. A few clarifying asks before we sign the amendment:

1) Can the 120% credit be scoped to billable inference tokens only (not internal telemetry tokens)?
2) Please include a clause that the 90-day freeze will include a minimum 72-hour customer notification window before any non-critical kernel rollouts thereafter.
3) We will need the RCA and the amendment draft to review legal and infra sign-off.

We will provisionally accept the credit & goodwill construct pending the formal DocuSign amendment and the RCA. Please send the DocuSign to contracts@halcyonhealth.com and the RCA to platform@halcyonhealth.com.

Best,
Elena Ortiz
Head of Platform Reliability, Halcyon Health
elena@halcyonhealth.com
